english.title: Aircraft commander / tug driver fail to report accident involving aircraft at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[aircraft commander]_
(B)_[tug driver]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), when an accident occurred involving that aircraft at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport, you failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the person who was the operator of the aircraft at the time of the accident, the identification marks of the aircraft and details of the accident to a constable through the published Airport telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(3)(a) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
